resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Oregon Lookouts say the cab was removed in 1974; firelookout.com says destroyed. The story uses removed and reports firelookout.com's wording.

The register and firelookout.com give 1934, and a 1960 inspection quoted on Oregon Lookouts says constructed 1934. An October 1933 newspaper item already calls the cabin the new cabin. The story uses 1934 and mentions the 1933 item.

sources.title: Sparta Butte - Forest Lookouts (historic newspaper excerpts)

notes_for_editor: Three sources, all sharing a core of 1934 build and 1974 removal. No source describes the site today, and no access information was found. The 1960 inspection gives elevation 4200 ft, but firelookout.com gives 4944 ft, which matches the brief's 1506.9 m; the 1960 figure is not used. The firelookout.com personnel entry for 1921-1923 predates the 1934 cab, so those years probably refer to an earlier station; the story names Harry Thomas with that caveat. The register's 1934 date and the 1933 'new cabin' item may refer to the same building. No photos added (the register page lists captions with National Archives and collection credits but no image URLs were read).
